Metta anisaṃsa(ya)sutta
Bud. Pāli. on merits of meditation an. friendliness; in prose; included in the Paritta an. also in Aṅguttara Nikāya, Ekādaśanipāta. In Tib. Kandjour (Mdo. XXX. 18) this sūtra is prefixed to the Metta Sutta (from Jātaka 538) an. given a. a sūtra called Maitrībhāvanāsūtra.
Colombo D. I. 283 (in a collection). 1149.
For a. Eng. transl., see Traductions de Gogerly, J. Ser. 6, Vol. XX (July-Dec. 1872) 226-31.
See also Maitrībhāvanāsūtra.
C.. AMG. V. 221.

Mettabhāvanā
Bud. Pāli. Bud. meditation on friendliness. Colombo D. I. 1147-48.

Mettasutta
Bud. Pāli. In verse, included in Paritta a. also in Jātaka 538 (where it is called Dasa-Mitta-pūjaka-Gāthā). In the Tib. Kandjour (Mdo. XXX 18); this sūtra is joined with the Metta-anisaṃsa(ya)sutta(of Paritta) [Page159-a. an. the two together called Maitrībhāvanāsūtra.
For a. Eng. transl., see Traductions de Gogerly, J. Ser. 6, Vol. XX (July-Dec. 1872) 226-31.
See also Maitrībhāvanāsūtra.
C.. AMG V. 221.
Pt.. (1) transl. by W. Skeen, Colombo, 1871. (2) in Vandanā gāthā Pota, 4th edn. Colombo, 1907.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 1167. 1403.
--from Khuddakapātha of Khuddakanikāya.
Pt.. Khuddakanikāya, I. p.. 11-12. Nālandā Dng. Pāli. Ser., Bihar, 1959.
See Wint. HIL. II. p. 77.
--from Suttanipāta of Khuddakanikāya.
Pt.. (1) Metrical transl. by Artthur P fungst, The Buddhist I. p.. 6-7, 1905. (2) with Siamese discourse by Pussadeva of Wat Rajapratistha, Bangkok, 1922. (3) Khuddakanikāya, I. p.. 290-91, Nālandā Dng. Pāli. Ser., Bihar, 1959.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 841, 1063.

Mettānusmṛti
Bud. Pāli. Bud. reflection an. meditation on friendliness. Colombo D. I. 1150.
